skill.name: socialdatax-short-video-copy-extract
skill.description: Use SocialDataX to transcribe public short videos and retrieve available video details. Get the original description, spoken transcript, copy-ready text, and a short summary.
skill.summary: Turn public short videos into transcripts, copy-ready text, and short summaries.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most alerts match Markdown formatting, transcription identifiers, vendor links, or Chinese prose rather than malicious behavior. The direct CLI runs an unpinned package with access to service credentials, including a documented local credential file. The workflow also lacks safe shell argument handling, polling limits, and an idempotent retry rule after an ambiguous submission failure.

remediation.suggestion: Pin every CLI invocation to a reviewed version. Verify package integrity and obtain approval before installing or upgrading it.
Pass links, share text, identifiers, and output paths as discrete arguments without invoking a shell. Validate the platform, identifier format, and output path.

remediation.issue: CLI access to environment and stored credentials
remediation.suggestion: Prefer scoped credentials from a secret manager and isolate the CLI from unrelated secrets. Document storage and revocation, and retain restrictive file permissions.

remediation.issue: Polling has no time or attempt limit
remediation.suggestion: Apply a maximum elapsed time and attempt count. Bound server-suggested delays and return the current job ID when polling stops.

remediation.issue: Ambiguous failures can lead to duplicate submissions
remediation.suggestion: Use an idempotency key or verify job creation before retrying. Disclose potential credit charges before asking the user to approve an uncertain retry.

semantic_findings.title: Shell templates expose untrusted input
semantic_findings.description: The CLI templates place links and share text inside double-quoted shell arguments. Literal substitution can interpret untrusted input as shell syntax.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow prefers shell commands and supplies no argument separation or escaping rule. Impact depends on how the agent builds each command.

semantic_findings.title: Unbounded transcription polling
semantic_findings.description: The agent must keep polling nonterminal jobs and use server-provided delays without a time or attempt limit. Stalled jobs can consume tool calls and session time.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly list the stop conditions and omit a polling budget. The same continuation rule applies to the hosted tools.

semantic_findings.title: Ambiguous failures can duplicate paid work
semantic_findings.description: The skill describes itself as read-only but submits jobs to a credit-based service. A missing job ID can trigger resubmission even if the service accepted the first request.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The retry rule uses absence of a returned ID without requiring idempotency or reconciliation. Actual duplicate charges depend on service behavior.

content.user_title: Extract transcripts from public short videos
content.value_statement: Spoken content in short videos can be hard to review or quote. Use SocialDataX to retrieve a transcript and turn it into copy-ready text and a short summary.
actual_capabilities: Submit a public video link, share text, or a platform-specific content ID for transcription.
Resume an existing transcription job by querying the same job ID on its original platform.
Show the spoken transcript alongside available video details and the original description.
Prepare copy-ready text and a short summary using the returned transcript and description.
Export timed subtitles to a new UTF-8 SRT file through the direct CLI when valid timing data is available.
limitations: The direct CLI supports public videos from RedNote, Douyin, Kuaishou, Weibo, and WeChat Channels only.
Processing requires an authenticated SocialDataX connection. Service requests may require credits.
The skill cannot supply metadata or timestamps that the service did not return.
SRT export requires direct CLI version 0.2.64 or later and valid timing data. Hosted MCP does not write local SRT files.

use_cases.title: Review spoken copy for an edit
use_cases.description: Extract the original description and spoken transcript from a public clip you produced. Use the copy-ready version to prepare approved editorial material.

use_cases.title: Compare a video with its post description
use_cases.description: Read the transcript and original description side by side. Use the short summary to decide whether the clip is relevant to your research.

use_cases.title: Prepare subtitles for review
use_cases.description: Export an SRT file from a completed job when timing data is available. Review the text and timing before distribution.

prompt_templates.title: Transcribe a public link
prompt_templates.prompt: Transcribe the speech in this public Douyin video: [video link]. Show the original description separately if it is available.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with one supported video link.

prompt_templates.prompt: Use this RedNote note ID: [note ID]. Give me the transcript, a copy-ready version, and a short summary. Mark missing details as unavailable.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use a platform content ID to request structured text.

prompt_templates.title: Continue a known job
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this existing Weibo transcription job: [job ID]. Query the same job without resubmitting the video. Report the current state if you cannot continue.
prompt_templates.scenario: Resume a task from an earlier session.

prompt_templates.title: Export timed subtitles
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this Kuaishou job: [job ID]. If it succeeded and returned valid timing, use the direct CLI to export a new SRT file to [path]. Do not overwrite a file or resubmit the video.
prompt_templates.scenario: Export subtitles from an existing job to a chosen location.

output_examples.input: Transcribe a public RedNote clip about adjusting a desk lamp.
output: Video: RedNote. Title: Adjusting a desk lamp.
Original description: A short guide to reducing screen glare.
Spoken transcript: Move the lamp to the side of your monitor. Tilt the shade down until the reflection disappears.
Copy-ready text: Place the lamp beside the monitor and tilt the shade down to reduce glare.
Summary: The clip shows how lamp placement and angle can reduce screen glare.

output_examples.input: Resume an existing Weibo job after the session can no longer poll for results.
output: Status: Still processing. No transcript is available yet.
Next step: Check the same Weibo job later without submitting the video again.

best_practices: Use one input per request and check that it belongs to a supported public video.
Reuse the original platform and job ID when following up on a pending transcription.
Choose a new file in a writable folder for subtitle export and verify the finished file.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat or include them in prompts.
Do not submit the video again when you already have a job ID.
Do not treat a pending job as a completed transcript or invent missing timestamps.

faq.question: Which platforms are supported?
faq.answer: The listed platforms are RedNote, Douyin, Kuaishou, Weibo, and WeChat Channels. The workflow is for public videos.

faq.question: What can I submit?
faq.answer: Use a public video link, share text, or a platform-specific content ID. To resume a job, provide its job ID and original platform.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: The direct CLI requires a configured SocialDataX key. A connected hosted MCP setup uses its existing authentication. Do not share keys in chat.

faq.question: Does this run offline?
faq.answer: No. Transcription and job lookup use SocialDataX. The direct CLI can save a subtitle file locally after the service returns valid timing data.

faq.question: When can I export subtitles?
faq.answer: Use direct CLI version 0.2.64 or later after a job succeeds with valid timing data. The destination must be new.

faq.question: What happens if I run out of credits?
faq.answer: The skill reports the balance error and shows the vendor billing page. Avoid repeated submissions or status checks until the balance issue is resolved.
